label: Folded AWG with MMI loop-mirror reflectors, 16 x 20 GHz design (10 effective channels), X-cut TFLN rib
core_material: X-cut LiNbO3 thin film 600 nm, 300 nm ridge etch (RIE), sidewalls about 75 deg
notes: Fab empty: p.8 Sec. 3 says the devices are fabricated with a 350 nm-resolution lithography process provided by IOPTEE; IOPTEE is not in the registry (reported). Single free-propagation region; each arrayed waveguide ends in a 1 x 2 MMI loop mirror that reflects light back (p.2-3, Fig. 1(b), Fig. 2(a)); the MMI building block is cmp_lit_xie2026_mmi_1x2. Arrayed waveguides: taper -> 100 um x 1.2 um single-mode section (EW) -> inverse taper -> 1.5 um multimode straight section (MW, carries the length increment) -> 90 deg bend (BW) -> MMI loop (p.5-6). Designed centre wavelength 1.55 um (Table 1); measured response 1553-1559 nm. Channels 1-6 are degraded (input-waveguide offset, slab clipping); channels 7-16 are the 10 effective channels (p.9-11). FSR and measured channel spacing are not printed; audit figure reads of Fig. 10: FSR about 2.89 nm (m20) and channel spacing about 0.146 nm, i.e. about 18 GHz against the 20 GHz design (m21; D417). The printed IL (< 11.9 dB) and uniformity (1.9 dB) match the first-FSR channels of Fig. 10(b); in the second FSR of Fig. 10(a) channel 16 peaks near -13.2 dB. IL normalized to a reference of two edge couplers and a straight waveguide (Fig. 9(c), cmp_lit_xie2026_edge_coupler_ref).
